build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball and bars with holes using define_task_template
create_bar_with_hole: create two static bars with a gap between them using the _bar_with_hole helper function
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene with a specified scale and position using C.add
update_task_goal: update the task goal to require the ball touching the bottom wall using C.update_task
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams when ball exceeds hole size
